0001: """Conservative per-function EH gate, not an EH equivalence checker.
0002: 
0003: Read CIE/FDE associations from .eh_frame. An actual LSDA blocks an
0004: instruction-only MATCH; personality targets are resolved and compared.
0005: Malformed or unsupported associations fail closed. Ordinary unwind-only
0006: FDEs do not reject unrelated functions in the same TU.
0007: """
0008: from dataclasses import dataclass
0009: 
0010: 
0011: class FrameError(ValueError):
0012:     pass
0013: 
0014: 
0015: class Reader:
0016:     def __init__(self, data, start=0, end=None):
0017:         self.data, self.pos = data, start
0018:         self.end = len(data) if end is None else end
0019: 
0020:     def take(self, size):
0021:         if size < 0 or self.pos + size > self.end:
0022:             raise FrameError("truncated EH frame")
0023:         out = self.data[self.pos:self.pos + size]
0024:         if len(out) != size:
0025:             raise FrameError("truncated EH section")
0026:         self.pos += size
0027:         return out
0028: 
0029:     def number(self, size, signed=False):
0030:         return int.from_bytes(self.take(size), "little", signed=signed)
0031: 
0032:     def leb(self, signed=False):
0033:         value = shift = 0
0034:         for _ in range(10):
0035:             byte = self.number(1)
0036:             value |= (byte & 127) << shift
0037:             shift += 7
0038:             if not byte & 128:
0039:                 return value - (1 << shift) if signed and byte & 64 else value
0040:         raise FrameError("oversized EH LEB128")
0041: 
0042:     def encoded(self, encoding, base):
0043:         if encoding == 255:
0044:             raise FrameError("omitted FDE address")
0045:         form = encoding & 15
0046:         pos = self.pos
0047:         if form == 0:
0048:             value = self.number(8)
0049:         elif form in (1, 9):
0050:             value = self.leb(form == 9)
0051:         elif form in (2, 3, 4, 10, 11, 12):
0052:             value = self.number({2: 2, 3: 4, 4: 8}[form & 7], bool(form & 8))
0053:         else:
0054:             raise FrameError("unsupported EH pointer format")
0055:         application = encoding & 112
0056:         if application == 16:
0057:             value += base + pos
0058:         elif application:
0059:             raise FrameError("unsupported EH pointer base")
0060:         if encoding & 128:
0061:             raise FrameError("indirect FDE address")
0062:         return value
0063: 
0064: 
0065: @dataclass
0066: class Frames:
0067:     # (code section index or None for a linked ELF, start, end, reason, personality)
0068:     ranges: list
0069:     error: str | None = None
0070: 
0071:     def reason(self, start, size, section=None):
0072:         if self.error:
0073:             return self.error
0074:         matches = [(lo, hi, why) for sec, lo, hi, why, _ in self.ranges
0075:                    if sec == section and lo < start + size and start < hi]
0076:         if any(lo > start or hi < start + size for lo, hi, _ in matches):
0077:             return "EH FDE partially overlaps function; association unverified"
0078:         if len(matches) > 1:
0079:             return "multiple EH FDEs overlap function; association unverified"
0080:         return matches[0][2] if matches else None
0081: 
0082:     def personalities(self, start, size, section=None):
0083:         return sorted({personality for sec, lo, hi, _, personality in self.ranges
0084:                        if sec == section and lo < start + size and start < hi and personality})
0085: 
0086: 
0087: def personality_name(image, field, width, value, encoding, relocatable, relocs):
0088:     if relocatable:
0089:         relocation = relocs.get(field)
0090:         if relocation is None or relocation.type not in (1, 2, 10, 11):
0091:             raise FrameError("unresolved EH personality relocation")
0092:         expected = {1: (0, 8), 2: (16, 4), 10: (0, 4), 11: (0, 4)}[relocation.type]
0093:         if (encoding & 112, width) != expected:
0094:             raise FrameError("unsupported EH personality relocation encoding")
0095:         symbol, addend = relocation.symbol, relocation.addend
0096:         if encoding & 128:
0097:             if not symbol.defined or not 0 < symbol.shndx < len(image.sections):
0098:                 raise FrameError("unresolved indirect EH personality")
0099:             targets = [r for r in image.relocs.get(symbol.shndx, []) if r.offset == symbol.value + addend]
0100:             if len(targets) != 1 or targets[0].type != 1:
0101:                 raise FrameError("unresolved indirect EH personality relocation")
0102:             symbol, addend = targets[0].symbol, targets[0].addend
0103:         if addend or not symbol.name or symbol.type == 3:
0104:             raise FrameError("unresolved EH personality symbol")
0105:         return symbol.name.split("@")[0]
0106:     if encoding & 128:
0107:         relocation = image.relocs.get(value)
0108:         if relocation and relocation.symbol and relocation.addend == 0:
0109:             return relocation.symbol.split("@")[0]
0110:         value = image.u64(value)
0111:     if value in image.plt:
0112:         return image.plt[value].split("@")[0]
0113:     names = {s.name.split("@")[0] for s in image.symbols + image.dynsyms
0114:              if s.defined and s.value == value and s.name}
0115:     if len(names) != 1:
0116:         raise FrameError("unresolved linked EH personality")
0117:     return names.pop()
0118: 
0119: 
0120: def inspect(image, relocatable=False):
0121:     ranges = []
0122:     sections = [s for s in image.sections if s.name == ".eh_frame" or s.name.startswith(".eh_frame.")]
0123:     if not sections and any(s.size and s.name in (".gcc_except_table", ".eh_frame_hdr") for s in image.sections):
0124:         return Frames([], "EH sections present without .eh_frame; association unverified")
0125:     try:
0126:         for section in sections:
0127:             data = image.data[section.offset:section.offset + section.size]
0128:             if len(data) != section.size:
0129:                 raise FrameError("truncated EH section")
0130:             relocs = {}
0131:             if relocatable:
0132:                 for relocation in image.relocs.get(section.index, []):
0133:                     if relocation.offset in relocs:
0134:                         raise FrameError("overlapping EH relocations")
0135:                     relocs[relocation.offset] = relocation
0136:             cies = {}
0137:             pos = 0
0138:             while pos < len(data):
0139:                 reader = Reader(data, pos)
0140:                 length = reader.number(4)
0141:                 if length == 0:
0142:                     if any(data[reader.pos:]):
0143:                         raise FrameError("data after EH terminator")
0144:                     break
0145:                 if length == 0xffffffff:
0146:                     raise FrameError("unsupported 64-bit EH frame length")
0147:                 end = reader.pos + length
0148:                 if end > len(data) or length < 4:
0149:                     raise FrameError("invalid EH frame length")
0150:                 reader.end = end
0151:                 id_pos = reader.pos
0152:                 cie_id = reader.number(4)
0153:                 if cie_id == 0:
0154:                     version = reader.number(1)
0155:                     if version not in (1, 3):
0156:                         raise FrameError("unsupported EH CIE version")
0157:                     augmentation = bytearray()
0158:                     while True:
0159:                         byte = reader.number(1)
0160:                         if byte == 0:
0161:                             break
0162:                         augmentation.append(byte)
0163:                     augmentation = augmentation.decode("ascii")
0164:                     reader.leb()
0165:                     reader.leb(True)
0166:                     reader.number(1) if version == 1 else reader.leb()
0167:                     encoding = 0
0168:                     personality = None
0169:                     lsda_encoding = 255
0170:                     if augmentation:
0171:                         if not augmentation.startswith("z"):
0172:                             raise FrameError("unsupported EH CIE augmentation")
0173:                         aug_size = reader.leb()
0174:                         aug = Reader(data, reader.pos, reader.pos + aug_size)
0175:                         reader.take(aug_size)
0176:                         for char in augmentation[1:]:
0177:                             if char == "R":
0178:                                 encoding = aug.number(1)
0179:                             elif char == "L":
0180:                                 lsda_encoding = aug.number(1)
0181:                             elif char == "P":
0182:                                 personality_encoding = aug.number(1)
0183:                                 field = aug.pos
0184:                                 value = aug.encoded(personality_encoding & ~128, section.addr)
0185:                                 personality = personality_name(image, field, aug.pos - field, value,
0186:                                                                personality_encoding, relocatable, relocs)
0187:                             elif char != "S":
0188:                                 raise FrameError("unsupported EH CIE augmentation")
0189:                         if aug.pos != aug.end:
0190:                             raise FrameError("unparsed EH CIE augmentation")
0191:                     cies[pos] = (encoding, augmentation.startswith("z"), lsda_encoding, personality)
0192:                 else:
0193:                     cie = cies.get(id_pos - cie_id)
0194:                     if cie is None:
0195:                         raise FrameError("unresolved EH CIE reference")
0196:                     encoding, augmented, lsda_encoding, personality = cie
0197:                     field = reader.pos
0198:                     start = reader.encoded(encoding, section.addr)
0199:                     size = reader.encoded(encoding & 15, 0)
0200:                     code_section = None
0201:                     if relocatable:
0202:                         relocation = relocs.get(field)
0203:                         if relocation is None or relocation.type not in (1, 2, 10, 11):
0204:                             raise FrameError("unresolved FDE code relocation")
0205:                         symbol = relocation.symbol
0206:                         if not symbol.defined or not 0 < symbol.shndx < len(image.sections):
0207:                             raise FrameError("unresolved FDE code symbol")
0208:                         expected = {1: (0, 8), 2: (16, 4), 10: (0, 4), 11: (0, 4)}[relocation.type]
0209:                         if encoding & 112 != expected[0] or reader.pos - field != expected[1] * 2:
0210:                             raise FrameError("unsupported FDE relocation encoding")
0211:                         code_section = symbol.shndx
0212:                         start = symbol.value + relocation.addend
0213:                     if size <= 0 or start < 0:
0214:                         raise FrameError("invalid FDE code range")
0215:                     code = image.sections[code_section] if relocatable else image.section_at(start)
0216:                     code_start = 0 if relocatable else code.addr if code else 0
0217:                     if code is None or not code.flags & 4 or start < code_start or start + size > code_start + code.size:
0218:                         raise FrameError("FDE range outside executable section")
0219:                     if augmented:
0220:                         aug_size = reader.leb()
0221:                         aug = Reader(data, reader.pos, reader.pos + aug_size)
0222:                         reader.take(aug_size)
0223:                         lsda = False
0224:                         if lsda_encoding != 255:
0225:                             lsda_field = aug.pos
0226:                             value = aug.encoded(lsda_encoding & ~128, section.addr)
0227:                             # Zero is the absent-LSDA sentinel even for PC-relative encoding.
0228:                             raw_nonzero = any(data[lsda_field:aug.pos])
0229:                             lsda = raw_nonzero or (relocatable and lsda_field in relocs)
0230:                         if aug.pos != aug.end:
0231:                             raise FrameError("unparsed EH FDE augmentation")
0232:                     else:
0233:                         lsda = False
0234:                     reason = "EH LSDA equivalence unverified" if lsda else None
0235:                     ranges.append((code_section, start, start + size, reason, personality))
0236:                 pos = end
0237:         return Frames(ranges)
0238:     except (FrameError, UnicodeError, IndexError, ValueError) as exc:
0239:         return Frames([], f"EH metadata unverified: {exc}")
